mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 1400K units, indicating strong demand, boosts consumer discretionary spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST surpasses 1400K.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 1.5% signals accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days, as investors seek higher yields.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 1.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment (UNRATE) drops below 3.2% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) grows by more than 200K in a month, the combined labor market strength predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly higher (t-test p > 0.1) in triggered instances compared to non-triggered periods.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) growth exceeding 5% YoY signals strong supply-side momentum, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Triggered instances result in negative SPX returns more than 30% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: Real GDP (GDPC1) growth slowing to below 2% QoQ indicates weakening demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) by more than 0.5% MoM, indicating inflation concerns, predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate tighter monetary policy.
failure_condition: Triggered instances result in positive SPX returns more than 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises by more than 0.2pp in a month and payroll employment (PAYEMS) growth is negative, the combined labor market weakness predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly lower (t-test p > 0.05) in triggered instances compared to non-triggered periods.

mechanism_narrative: Retail and Food Services Sales (RSAFS) growth slowing to below 0.5% MoM, indicating weakening consumer spending, leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days, as investors reassess growth prospects.
failure_condition: Triggered instances result in positive SPX returns more than 55% of the time.
